description: Checks one of a project's preview domains now instead of waiting for CodeGene's own check (every minute in its first hour), and answers whether its records are in and every preview address with its state. Use it when the person says they added the records. It changes nothing the person has not already asked for.

domain.description: The preview domain, such as preview.acme.com.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: check_preview_domain
title: Check a preview domain now
